title: Textmode document 2.0
description: Editable textmode cell snapshots and layer stacks.

positiveSafeInteger.description: Positive integer in the interoperable JavaScript safe range.

width.description: Width in pixels; the decoder checks equality with the corresponding grid product.

height.description: Height in pixels; the decoder checks equality with the corresponding grid product.

canvas.description: Legacy grid pixel extent. For selected documents this equals the grid extent; for all documents it equals the first layer grid extent. It is not a composite viewport. See docs/specification-2.0.md#canvas-field.

grid.description: Logical cell count and pixel dimensions of each cell. Products must remain safe integers.

a.description: Alpha: 0 is transparent and 255 is opaque.

rgba.description: Unpremultiplied RGBA integer channels from 0 through 255.

color.description: RGB or RGBA hexadecimal notation, or explicit RGBA channels. Six-digit notation implies alpha 255.

invert.description: Glyph inversion; alpha means this cannot generally be replaced by swapping colors.

rotation.description: Cell rotation in degrees; normalized by the decoder to [0, 360).

transform.description: Per-cell glyph transforms. Rotation is finite degrees; decoding normalizes it to [0, 360).

x.description: Zero-based column index; must equal the position within its row.

y.description: Zero-based row index; must equal the row position.

character.description: Nonempty Unicode glyph string, preserved without normalization. The decoder rejects unpaired surrogates and enforces a scalar-count budget.

background.description: Cell background color with alpha. A space with a visible background remains meaningful.

transform.description: Per-cell glyph inversion, flips, and rotation.

cell.description: One cell at its redundant zero-based row and column. Coordinates must match array position; this cross-field rule is checked by the decoder.

encoding.description: Tagged cell encoding; v2 supports only object-rows-v1.

rows.description: Dense row-major arrays; row count and lengths must equal the owning grid. The decoder checks this invariant.

cells.description: Dense row-major cells, including transparent cells. Row count and lengths must equal the grid. See docs/specification-2.0.md#cell-encoding.

createdAt.description: Real calendar date and time with uppercase T and timezone, required seconds, optional fractional seconds, and no leap seconds. Enable date-time format assertions in validators.

generator.description: Producer identity; it does not select executable behavior.

metadata.description: Optional informational creation and generator metadata. When present, both members are required.

id.description: Nonempty informational source identifier. It is not a persistent cross-document identity; the decoder does not enforce uniqueness.

selectedLayer.description: Informational source ID and cells. A selected snapshot does not carry layer presentation or font identity.

id.description: Nonempty informational source identifier. It is not a persistent cross-document identity; the decoder does not enforce uniqueness.

visible.description: Whether the layer participates in presentation. Hidden cells are still stored.

opacity.description: Layer opacity from 0 through 1, separate from cell alpha.

blendMode.description: Nonempty blend mode name. The decoder preserves unknown names; apps decide which they can present.

rotationZ.description: Layer rotation in degrees, clockwise about the layer center in textmode.js; preserved by the decoder.

stackLayer.description: One ordered layer with independent grid, cells, and presentation values.

formatVersion.description: On-disk format version, independent of package versions.

target.description: Shape discriminator: selected uses layer and root grid; all uses layers.

canvas.description: Legacy grid pixel extent, not the final canvas or a composite viewport.

selectedDocument.description: Selected cell snapshot. All listed properties except metadata are required.

formatVersion.description: On-disk format version, independent of package versions.

target.description: Shape discriminator: selected uses layer and root grid; all uses layers.

canvas.description: Legacy grid pixel extent, not the final canvas or a composite viewport.

layers.description: Nonempty ordered layer stack, bottom first.

allDocument.description: One or more layers in bottom-to-top order. The decoder applies cumulative cell and layer budgets.
